summary_1line: Yudhishthira duels Drona but retreats weaponless; elsewhere several fierce duels occur, including Vrihatkshatra and Sahadeva slaying their opponents.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira’s blazing dart streaks across the sky like a fiery serpent while Drona counters with the Brahma weapon.
Two hurled maces collide mid-air, bursting sparks before crashing to the earth between Drona and Yudhishthira.
The severed, diademed head of Kshemadhurti falls from his chariot, shining like a fallen star upon the battlefield.
